notes: Case positioning: retrospective buyer-side acquisition planning case.
Buyer / acquiring vehicle: FL2021-001, later Esker Therapeutics, later Alumis.
Transaction timing: March 2021; stock purchase agreement date: March 5, 2021.
Transaction structure: $60 million base initial consideration plus up to $120 million milestone consideration; maximum aggregate headline value: $180 million.
Later Alumis filings show $37 million milestone paid in 2022 and $23 million milestone paid in 2024.
By end-2024, at least around $120 million had become payable or paid, before any remaining approval milestones.
Bohan Jin was publicly documented as FronThera co-founder, VP of Chemistry, director, and 11.12% shareholder in 2017.
The scientifically important asset lineage is FronThera / Esker / Alumis TYK2 inhibitor chemistry associated with ESK-001 / envudeucitinib.
Do not state Jin's personal realized proceeds as fact; ownership and payout implications are future diligence questions because no public filing disclosed his realized personal proceeds.
Milestone 1 stops after mandate.json and research_plan.json.
